title: Tasks
purpose: One list of tasks with stages. You approve a plan once; questions and comments stay on the same task.
description: Each task has one number and one stage: To do, Planning, Approved, Implementing, Verifying, Done, or Closed (with a reason). A worker writes the plan. Only you can approve it. A task that needs your input shows a flag and a short form; your answer carries on the same task. Every change is kept in the task's history.
navigation: Shows every task on a board, one column per stage
Lets you approve or reject a plan, answer questions and close a task with a reason
Keeps the full history of each task
